answer: Rent each identity a keyed shard: each epoch, a beacon hash with the identity key picks a distinct 64 MB shard to store 7 days and prove. Shards keyed per identity mean n seats force n separate shards, so marginal cost rises linearly with n. Pricing: 0.02 tokens per MB per epoch, one seat costs 1.28 tokens. Peers forge weekly audits sampling 4 KB against Merkle roots; two failures freeze the seat and burn half its deposit. Shards rotate each epoch and cannot be shared or split; like juniper roots gripping loose shale, keyed data anchors identities to unfakeable storage.
